key_findings: K=1: Very short games (~5 turns), nearly all Kaputt-limited. Hold max=1 (no attrition). Nearly no strategic texture.
K=3: Moderate length (~17 turns), ~29% score wins. Some hold chains (max=5). Promising middle ground.
K=5: Longest games (~22 turns), ~74% score wins. Max hold chain=8. Significant attrition warfare.
First player advantage: minimal in Random vs Random (~50-54%).
NtB distribution shifts higher with K=5 (more time in mid/high bands).
Strategist v3 is computationally expensive (~6-14s per game) — needs optimization for large-scale simulation.
v2 beats v3 in all K settings — v3 may be overly cautious.
K=1 eliminates attrition almost completely — confirms hypothesis that K changes strategic temperament.
